title: Google Ad Manager - Integrated Advertising Management Platform

facts.fact: Google Ad Manager describes itself on its homepage as an integrated advertising management platform for managing an entire ads business from one platform.
facts.quote: manage your entire ads business from one easy-to-use, integrated platform.

facts.fact: A Dotdash case study on the Ad Manager page says Dotdash restructured its advertising tech setup and implemented Exchange Bidding.
facts.quote: Dotdash restructured their advertising tech setup and implemented Exchange Bidding to ensure that their ad experiences performed as effectively as their sites.
